rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Recruiting agents must register and furnish a bank guarantee that can be forfeited; no joint liability with the employer.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Service charges are capped by the Rules (at present ₹30,000 including tax); no cap applies to emigrants who do not need emigration clearance.

rules.v: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
rules.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
rules.n: Clearance requires a contract only for holders of ECR passports going to the 18 listed countries; other workers emigrate without state review of the contract.

rules.v: No compulsory orientation
rules.vi: Tidak ada orientasi wajib
rules.n: Pre-departure orientation (PDOT) is offered but is not a condition of emigration.

rules.v: Coverage is limited to some categories of workers or to some of these risks
rules.vi: Cakupan terbatas pada sebagian kategori pekerja atau sebagian risiko
rules.n: The Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana is compulsory only for ECR workers (death and permanent disability up to ₹10 lakh, repatriation, legal expenses); the Indian Community Welfare Fund at missions rests on guidelines.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: Labor and welfare wings exist in missions in the Gulf and elsewhere by administrative decision; the Act creates no such duty.

rules.v: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
rules.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
rules.n: Protectors of Emigrants can suspend or cancel an agent's certificate and forfeit the guarantee; compensation needs the courts.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
rules.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
rules.n: Since 2007 women under 30 holding ECR passports are not granted clearance to work in the ECR countries; the rule applies to women only.
rules.s: MEA FAQ and guidelines on emigration clearance; parliamentary answers

rules.v: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: No statutory reintegration duty at the national level; states such as Kerala run reintegration schemes (NORKA).

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: The Indian Community Welfare Fund pays for shelters for workers in distress at some missions.

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: The MADAD portal and mission helplines; some missions run 24-hour lines.

rules.v: Legal assistance is funded by policy or discretionary funds
rules.vi: Bantuan hukum dibiayai berdasarkan kebijakan atau dana diskresioner
rules.n: The ICWF funds legal assistance at the mission's discretion; no statutory basis.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: Advisories and ICWF assistance for women in distress; no specific statutory provision found.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: PBBY (for ECR workers) and the ICWF cover repatriation of remains; no independent examination route found.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: Trafficking is an offense under the general criminal law, with limited victim provisions
rules.vi: Perdagangan orang adalah tindak pidana dalam hukum pidana umum, dengan ketentuan korban yang terbatas
rules.n: Trafficking is an offense under the general criminal law (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 s. 143, formerly IPC s. 370); a comprehensive trafficking bill (2018) lapsed.

decisions.nm: In Re: Problems and Miseries of Migrant Labourers
decisions.pe: During COVID-19, millions of workers who had moved within India lost their jobs and could not get food rations away from home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to register them and let them use their ration card anywhere in the country.
decisions.pi: Selama COVID-19, jutaan pekerja yang merantau di dalam India kehilangan pekerjaan dan tidak bisa mendapat jatah pangan di luar daerah asal. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah mendaftar mereka dan membolehkan kartu jatah pangan dipakai di seluruh negeri.

decisions.nm: People’s Union for Democratic Rights v. Union of India (Asiad workers)
decisions.pe: Workers from other states built stadiums in Delhi for the Asian Games and were paid less than the legal minimum. The Supreme Court said paying below the minimum wage is a form of forced labour.
decisions.pi: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain membangun stadion di Delhi untuk Asian Games dan dibayar di bawah upah minimum. MA menyatakan membayar di bawah upah minimum adalah bentuk kerja paksa.

decisions.nm: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Workers brought from other states to stone quarries near Delhi were trapped by debts. The Supreme Court ordered the government to free them and enforce labour laws.
decisions.pi: Pekerja yang didatangkan dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi terjerat utang. MA memerintahkan pemerintah membebaskan mereka dan menegakkan hukum ketenagakerjaan.

decisions.nm: Labourers Working on Salal Hydro Project v. State of Jammu and Kashmir
decisions.pe: Workers from other states building a dam were denied basic labour rights. The Supreme Court ordered the authorities to apply the law that protects workers who migrate between states.
decisions.pi: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain yang membangun bendungan tidak mendapat hak dasar. MA memerintahkan otoritas menerapkan UU yang melindungi pekerja yang merantau antarnegara bagian.

decisions.nm: National Campaign Committee for Central Legislation on Construction Labour v. Union of India
decisions.pe: India collects a levy on building projects for construction workers, many of them migrants. The Supreme Court found most of the money was not reaching them and ordered the government to register workers and use the funds properly.
decisions.pi: India memungut iuran dari proyek bangunan untuk pekerja konstruksi, banyak di antaranya perantau. MA menemukan sebagian besar dana tidak sampai kepada mereka dan memerintahkan pendataan pekerja serta penggunaan dana dengan benar.

decisions.nm: Chairman, Railway Board v. Chandrima Das
decisions.pe: A woman from Bangladesh was raped by railway staff at a station in Kolkata. The Supreme Court said the right to life protects foreigners too and ordered the railways to pay her.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Bangladesh diperkosa staf kereta api di stasiun Kolkata. MA menyatakan hak hidup juga melindungi orang asing dan memerintahkan perusahaan kereta api membayar ganti rugi.

decisions.nm: National Human Rights Commission v. State of Arunachal Pradesh
decisions.pe: Chakma families who had lived in Arunachal Pradesh for decades were threatened with being driven out. The Supreme Court ordered the state to protect them and to deal with their citizenship claims.
decisions.pi: Keluarga Chakma yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Arunachal Pradesh diancam diusir. MA memerintahkan negara bagian melindungi mereka dan memproses permohonan kewarganegaraan mereka.

decisions.nm: Louis De Raedt v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Foreign missionaries who had lived in India since before independence were told to leave. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no right to stay, though their lives and liberty are protected.
decisions.pi: Misionaris asing yang tinggal di India sejak sebelum kemerdekaan disuruh pergi. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak berhak tinggal, meski hidup dan kebebasannya dilindungi.

decisions.nm: Mohammad Salimullah v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Rohingya refugees detained in Jammu asked the Supreme Court to stop their deportation to Myanmar. The court refused to stop it for now.
decisions.pi: Pengungsi Rohingya yang ditahan di Jammu meminta MA menghentikan deportasi mereka ke Myanmar. Pengadilan menolak menghentikannya untuk sementara.

decisions.nm: Neeraja Chaudhary v. State of Madhya Pradesh
decisions.pe: Workers brought from other states to quarries near Delhi were freed from debt bondage but left with nothing. The Supreme Court said the state must also help them start again.
decisions.pi: Pekerja yang dibawa dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi dibebaskan dari jeratan utang tetapi dibiarkan tanpa apa-apa. MA menyatakan negara juga wajib membantu mereka memulai lagi.

decisions.nm: Sarbananda Sonowal v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Assam had its own law under which the state had to prove that someone was an illegal migrant. The Supreme Court struck it down, so people now have to prove they are citizens themselves.
decisions.pi: Assam punya UU sendiri yang mewajibkan negara membuktikan seseorang migran ilegal. MA membatalkannya, sehingga kini orang harus membuktikan sendiri bahwa mereka warga negara.

decisions.nm: In re Section 6A of the Citizenship Act
decisions.pe: Groups in Assam argued that the law giving citizenship to earlier migrants from Bangladesh was unconstitutional. The Supreme Court upheld the law, so those people keep their citizenship.
decisions.pi: Kelompok di Assam berpendapat UU yang memberi kewarganegaraan kepada migran awal dari Bangladesh inkonstitusional. MA mempertahankan UU itu, sehingga mereka tetap menjadi warga negara.

decisions.nm: Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (children in circuses)
decisions.pe: Children, many of them brought from Nepal, were found working and abused in Indian circuses. The Supreme Court banned child labour in circuses and ordered rescues and rehabilitation.
decisions.pi: Anak-anak, banyak yang dibawa dari Nepal, ditemukan bekerja dan dianiaya di sirkus India. MA melarang pekerja anak di sirkus dan memerintahkan penyelamatan dan rehabilitasi.

decisions.nm: Vishal Jeet v. Union of India
decisions.pe: A lawyer asked the Supreme Court to act on girls forced into prostitution, some brought from neighbouring countries. The court told governments to enforce the law and help the girls rebuild their lives.
decisions.pi: Seorang advokat meminta MA bertindak terhadap anak perempuan yang dipaksa melacur, sebagian dibawa dari negara tetangga. Pengadilan memerintahkan pemerintah menegakkan hukum dan membantu mereka membangun hidup kembali.

decisions.nm: Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation
decisions.pe: Eviction of pavement dwellers, many of them internal migrant workers; right to livelihood.
decisions.pi: Penggusuran penghuni trotoar, banyak di antaranya pekerja migran internal; hak atas penghidupan.

decisions.nm: Sanjit Roy v. State of Rajasthan
decisions.pe: Paying less than the minimum wage on famine relief works treated as forced labour.
decisions.pi: Upah di bawah upah minimum pada proyek bantuan kelaparan dianggap kerja paksa.

decisions.nm: M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu (child labour)
decisions.pe: Child labour in match and fireworks factories; compensation and welfare fund.
decisions.pi: Pekerja anak di pabrik korek api dan kembang api; ganti rugi dan dana kesejahteraan.

decisions.nm: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India (carpet industry)
decisions.pe: Child labour in the carpet industry; release and rehabilitation.
decisions.pi: Pekerja anak di industri karpet; pembebasan dan rehabilitasi.

decisions.nm: Gaurav Jain v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Rescue and rehabilitation of women and children in forced prostitution, including trafficked persons.
decisions.pi: Penyelamatan dan rehabilitasi perempuan dan anak dalam prostitusi paksa, termasuk korban perdagangan.

decisions.nm: State of Arunachal Pradesh v. Khudiram Chakma
decisions.pe: Chakma refugees, residence and the power to order them to leave.
decisions.pi: Pengungsi Chakma, izin tinggal, dan kewenangan memerintahkan mereka pergi.

decisions.nm: Hans Muller of Nuremberg v. Superintendent, Presidency Jail
decisions.pe: Power to expel foreigners and the limits of detention pending expulsion.
decisions.pi: Kewenangan mengusir orang asing dan batas penahanan sebelum pengusiran.

decisions.nm: Ktaer Abbas Habib Al Qutaifi v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Non-refoulement read into the right to life for refugees facing deportation.
decisions.pi: Prinsip non-refoulement dibaca dalam hak hidup bagi pengungsi yang akan dideportasi.

decisions.nm: Dongh Lian Kham v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Deportation of a refugee from Myanmar and the principle of non-refoulement.
decisions.pi: Deportasi pengungsi dari Myanmar dan prinsip non-refoulement.

decisions.nm: Assam Sanmilita Mahasangha v. Union of India
decisions.pe: Reference to a Constitution Bench on citizenship of migrants in Assam.
decisions.pi: Rujukan ke Majelis Konstitusi tentang kewarganegaraan migran di Assam.

decisions.nm: Sarbananda Sonowal v. Union of India (II)
decisions.pe: Second challenge, to the Foreigners (Tribunals for Assam) Order 2006.
decisions.pi: Gugatan kedua, terhadap Perintah Tribunal Orang Asing untuk Assam 2006.

help.de: Free 24-hour helpline of India's Ministry of External Affairs for Indian workers abroad and their families, in 11 languages. Staff help file grievances on the MADAD and e-Migrate portals.
help.di: Saluran gratis 24 jam Kementerian Luar Negeri India bagi pekerja India di luar negeri dan keluarganya, dalam 11 bahasa. Petugas membantu mengajukan pengaduan di portal MADAD dan e-Migrate.
